message.content:
I've reviewed Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, filed November 1, 2024) and the current quote. Here's my read, then the order.

**Fundamentals (FY2024):** Total net sales $391.0B, up 2% year over year, with Services the growth engine (+13% to $96.2B) offsetting flat iPhone revenue and an 8% decline in Greater China. Total gross margin expanded to 46.2% (from 44.1%), driven by Services' 73.9% margin, and operating income rose to $123.2B from $114.3B. Net income of $93.7B and diluted EPS of $6.08 were down slightly versus FY2023, but that's almost entirely explained by a one-time $10.2B net income tax charge tied to the EU State Aid decision (which pushed the effective tax rate to 24.1% from 14.7%); pre-tax earnings actually grew to $123.5B. Operating cash flow was strong at $118.3B, the balance sheet carries $140.8B in unrestricted cash and marketable securities, and the company returned ~$110B to shareholders ($95.0B of buybacks plus $15.2B of dividends) while raising the quarterly dividend to $0.25. The main watch items are the DOJ/EU antitrust and DMA matters and Greater China weakness — risks worth monitoring but not thesis-breaking.

**Quote:** AAPL last $222.70 / bid $222.68 / ask $222.72 as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC.

**Sizing within mandate:** $10,000 max per order → 44 shares at a $223.00 limit = ~$9,812, comfortably under the cap, near the current market price (about 0.13% above the ask), buy-only, and funded from existing $50,000 cash with no money movement out of the account. No prior trades today, so total exposure stays well under the $20,000 daily cap.
